==Description==
This template is used to add the [[Wikipedia:Sound correspondences between English accents|IPA]] phonetic notation of a subject when available.

==Usage==
*Place <code><nowiki>{{Pronounced|IPA|file=}}</nowiki></code> immediately after the first mention of the subject's name in the introduction and the article body. Replace "IPA" with the appropiate [[Wikipedia:IPA chart for English dialects|IPA]] phonetic notation.
*If a corresponding audio file is available, add the full file name to "file=", but exclude the "File:" prefix. Otherwise, remove the "|file=" parameter.

==Examples==
<code><nowiki>{{Pronounced|ˈkɹeɪə}}</nowiki></code>

results in...

{{Pronounced|ˈkɹeɪə}}
